CONTACT_TIME.TITLE: Contact time
CONTACT_TIME.FIRST_RESPONSE_INFO: How long the advisor takes to reply to a new lead's first message — measures how fast initial contact happens.
CONTACT_TIME.REPLY_TIME_INFO: Median advisor reply time across ALL replies in the conversation (not just the first one) — measures how responsive the conversation stays once it starts.

DEALS.CONVERSION_RATE_INFO: Percentage of leads from the period that converted into a deal.

CALLS.TITLE: Calls (Aircall)
CALLS.TOTAL_INFO: Aircall calls logged for this development during the period.
CALLS.ANSWERED_PERCENT_INFO: Percentage of calls that were answered (excludes missed/unanswered calls).
CALLS.DIRECTION_INFO: Calls the customer made to the advisor vs. calls the advisor made to the customer.
CALLS.VOICEMAIL_PERCENT_INFO: Of the answered calls, the percentage that were actually voicemail/answering machine (not a real conversation), based on AI call analysis.
CALLS.VOICEMAIL_RECOVERED_PERCENT_INFO: Of the voicemail calls, the percentage where the same lead was later reached with a real conversation.
CALLS.VOICEMAIL_RECOVERY_TIME_INFO: Average time between the voicemail call and the next real conversation with the same lead, for calls that were recovered.
CALLS.VOICEMAIL_NOT_YET_ANALYZED_INFO: Answered calls in this period that don't have an AI analysis yet — voicemail metrics above are based only on already-analyzed calls.

PIPELINE.TITLE: Sales pipeline
PIPELINE.ACTIVITY_BADGE_TOOLTIP: Part of this number (and %) comes from deals created this period whose lead arrived earlier — not part of the new-leads cohort, but it does count here and toward the goal. See the 'Deals that moved this week' block.
PIPELINE.EXTERNAL_BADGE_TOOLTIP: Part of this number (and %) comes from deals with no Chatwoot contact at all — leads who never wrote in via WhatsApp (e.g. captured directly in Zoho via Meta Ads).

DEALS_ACTIVITY.TITLE: Deals that moved this week
DEALS_ACTIVITY.TOTAL_INFO: Zoho deals created in this period, regardless of when the lead first arrived — unlike the sales funnel, which only counts deals from leads whose first conversation fell in this period.
DEALS_ACTIVITY.VISITA_EFECTIVA_INFO: Of the deals created this period, how many are already in the effective-visit stage (as of today).
DEALS_ACTIVITY.CLOSED_WON_INFO: Of the deals created this period, how many already closed won (as of today).
